notes:
Ronald died as an infant less than 2 months old evidently from some severe form of gastro-intestinal problem.  Ronald was buried in Brookside Cemetery in Lot No.748 per certificate No. 6009. On Ronald's Certificate of Baptism, his name is shown as Ronald Arvin Zelmer.  On October 11, 2005, Lorna and Allan Zelmer visited this gravesite and found it. It is in "Section P" immediately to the right (facing north) to a grave marked with a flat, ground level stone with the name Stark, Jackie Wyper.

-Allan Zelmer
